invariants.rationale: The method returns early if wrap is true and otherwise continues; thus at exit, wrap could be either value.
At this program point, the return associated with wrap==true has already executed, so wrap must be false.
If reverse is true, then the loop completes with i == n == -1.
If reverse is false, then the loop completes with i == n == children.size.
getChildren() is dereferenced and used in the method, so it must be non-null at exit.
